output.population: Adults with histologically confirmed primary glioblastoma who underwent preoperative neuroimaging before surgery; raw MRI for 337 patients, ages 29–86
output.summary: Multi-center preoperative brain MRI from adults with primary glioblastoma, including T1-weighted pre- and post-contrast, T2-weighted and FLAIR scans, defaced anatomicals, skull-stripped MNI152-registered derivatives, and neuroradiologist-reviewed tumor segmentation masks.
